facts.fact: Chad's customs directorate says its SYDONIA World system processes declarations, with e-payment of all duties and taxes linked to it since 21 February 2024.

TCD.note: Customs agency services only, not a government-wide portal.
Tax number is not stated as the national ID number.

facts.fact: Chad's customs directorate says customs duties can be paid instantly by mobile money through Moov Money, Airtel Money and other approved operators.

Chad's customs e-payment system, launched 21 February 2024, lets all customs duties and taxes be paid electronically by SYDONIA World tele-payment, bank transfer or mobile money, with an automatic receipt.

TCD.note: E-Tax is named only as integrated with customs; online filing or payment of taxes not stated.

facts.fact: Chad's customs directorate says every importer, exporter or agent needs a valid taxpayer number (NIF) that is verifiable online.
Chad's customs directorate says a valid NIF is required for every customs declaration, and SYDONIA blocks declarations without one.
